description: Canonical product registry (VIT-DOM-004). Derived only from the product list that existed in service/report-domain.mjs and site/submission.mjs at baseline bba1d59; no products were added. Names that do not resolve are refused, never mapped to another product. 'unknown' is an explicit reporter choice, not a fallback.
aliasMatching: Unicode NFKC, trim, collapse internal whitespace to one space, lower-case. Ids and display names are always aliases of their own product.
